summary: Completed testing of Hotel Management System past-date booking bug fix. All backend API tests pass (6/6). The fix addresses: 1) Race condition in frontend login where axios Authorization header wasn't set before /api/auth/me call, 2) Status inconsistency in backend where 'Checked-in' and 'Checked In' were used interchangeably.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix correctly sets axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] immediately after login before calling /api/auth/me
Backend now handles both 'Checked-in' and 'Checked In' status variants in all queries
Past-date booking with 'Checked In' status correctly creates customer record and updates room status to 'Occupied'
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created with TEST_ prefix for cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Past-date booking bug fix verified. All 6 backend tests pass: login, /api/auth/me endpoint (no 403), past-date booking with 'Checked In' status, past-date booking with 'Upcoming' status, regular check-in flow, and status variant queries. Frontend login and dashboard work correctly. The fix ensures axios Authorization header is set immediately after login before making authenticated requests.
